issue_context.title: br: allow restore while log backup is enabled
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, `restore` is forbidden when log backup task is there in order to assure the recoverability of the restored tables.
While in SaaS environment, it's a strong requirement to migrate data of certain schema/table using br `restore`. At that case, tidb br needs to lift the restriction and permit schema/table level restore even though log backup task is there, and also, the restored tables should be backed up by the log backup task.

review_comments: missing license header？

one question, IDE has warning about the style
```
Struct WithMigrations has methods on both value and pointer receivers. Such usage is not recommended by the Go Documentation. 
```
and for many other structs as well. I'm wondering if we are doing impl for both on purpose or by accident?

Most of times are by accident. A typical scenario is that a structure was treated as value type (which has only value receivers) at the beginning, but with developing, we have noticed that sometimes it need to be a reference type (say, needing mutate its content by a method), then a method with pointer was added.
A risk here if pitr command is exposed to sql statement later. it might panic the tidb instance. so far, it's ok.
If I recall correctly TiDB captures panic for each connection, so hopefully this won't make the TiDB node crash
Can we add retry and CAS support?
since go sdk already has default backoff mechanism, it's ok no retry by caller.
also only used in test, should we move it?
We cannot move this to test file because this function uses the private structure `tidbSession`. This function is somehow a public constructor of `tidbSession`.
missing license header？

not big issue, but if enable==false, this goPersister will leak.
and resetCommitting seems duplicated with PerpareMig
If there is no task, we will return eariler:
if enable==false, it won't return eariler.
It is an internal function, I think we can control don't call it when `enabled` is false...
Anyway we can modify `close` to make it always close the background goroutine to be defensive.
ditto
seems duplicated with `LogFileManager.Stats`
In fact `LogFileManager.Stats` points to this. That stats is an output port.
typo? success
it's a bit weird to print metrics instead of integrating it into the existing dashboard, is it because br cannot publish stats to prometheus?
Yes, perhaps we need a Push Gateway... Raw Prometheus isn't pretty friendly to batch operations...

the jitter is a bit weird, looks like it's always going to be above 2500? I guess why don't we set jitter to be 2500 and just do `rand.Uint32()%JitterMs`

also can move this to a method in the retry module, feels like going to be needed in many case so don't need to rewrite the jitter calculation every time
why not check enable() here?
In fact only `onBatch` and `close` might be called with `enabled == false`... Other places are optional defensive code.
can add some comment to this struct since its logic is important to the whole feature.
